cards.ex: The company was cooking the books to hide its losses.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yo'qotishlarini yashirish uchun buxgalteriya hisobotlarini soxtalashtirgan.
cards.uzDef: Buxgalteriya hisobotlarini qasddan noto'g'ri ko'rsatish, firibgarlik qilish.

cards.ex: The police suspect it was an inside job because the security system was disabled.
cards.exUz: Politsiya buni ichki ish deb gumon qilmoqda, chunki xavfsizlik tizimi o'chirilgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat, kompaniya ichidagi odamlar tomonidan qilingan.

cards.ex: He cut a deal with the prosecutor to testify against his accomplices.
cards.exUz: U sheriklariga qarshi guvohlik berish uchun prokuror bilan kelishuvga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ayblanuvchi aybini tan olib, jazoni kamaytirish uchun kelishuvga erishish.

cards.ex: White-collar crime often goes unreported because it's difficult to detect.
cards.exUz: Oq yoqali jinoyatlar ko'pincha aniqlash qiyinligi sababli xabar qilinmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Moliyaviy jinoyatlar, masalan, firibgarlik yoki korruptsiya.

cards.ex: The suspect was taken into custody after a brief chase.
cards.exUz: Gumonlanuvchi qisqa ta'qibdan so'ng qamoqqa olindi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsni hibsga olish va politsiya nazoratiga olish.

cards.ex: The judge's conduct was beyond reproach throughout the trial.
cards.exUz: Sudya sud jarayonida aybsiz edi.
cards.uzDef: Ayblanmaydigan, hech qanday xato topib bo'lmaydigan.

cards.ex: The alleged accomplice denied any involvement in the robbery.
cards.exUz: Taxminiy sherik o'g'rilikda ishtirok etganini rad etdi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatda ishtirok etganligi taxmin qilinayotgan shaxs.

cards.ex: He was released early on good behavior.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi xulqi uchun muddatidan oldin ozod qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Ozodlikka chiqarilganidan keyin yaxshi xulq-atvor qoidalariga rioya qilish.

cards.ex: The robbery happened in broad daylight, right in front of the bank.
cards.exUz: O'g'irlik kunduzi, bankning oldida sodir bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq joyda, hech kim yashirinmaydigan vaqtda.

cards.ex: Many people believe his conviction was a miscarriage of justice.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar uning hukmi adolat buzilishi deb hisoblashadi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri hukm, aybsiz odamning aybdor deb topilishi.

cards.ex: She testified under oath that she saw the defendant at the scene.
cards.exUz: U sudlanuvchini voqea joyida ko'rganini qasamyod ostida aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda rost gapirishga qasamyod qilgandan so'ng.

cards.ex: The email was the smoking gun that proved he was involved.
cards.exUz: Elektron pochta xabar u ishtirok etganini isbotlovchi asosiy dalil edi.
cards.uzDef: Aybdorlikni isbotlovchi aniq dalil.

cards.ex: He was charged as an accessory to the crime.
cards.exUz: U jinoyatga sheriklik qilishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat sodir etilishida yordam bergan shaxs.

cards.ex: He got off with a slap on the wrist for such a serious offense.
cards.exUz: U bunday jiddiy jinoyat uchun engil jazo oldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda engil jazo, hech qanday jiddiy oqibatlarga olib kelmaydi.

cards.ex: The judge considered the extenuating circumstances before sentencing.
cards.exUz: Sudya hukm chiqarishdan oldin yumshatuvchi holatlarni ko'rib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatni qisman oqlaydigan vaziyatlar.

cards.ex: His behavior towards the witness was beyond the pale.
cards.exUz: Uning guvohga nisbatan xatti-harakati me'yordan tashqari edi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan, juda yomon xatti-harakat.

cards.ex: She confessed under duress after hours of interrogation.
cards.exUz: U soatlab so'roqdan so'ng majburan tan oldi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir bosimi ostida, o'z ixtiyori bilan emas.

cards.ex: He followed the letter of the law, but not its spirit.
cards.exUz: U qonun harfiga amal qildi, lekin uning ruhiga emas.
cards.uzDef: Qonunning so'zma-so'z ma'nosi, asl mohiyatini hisobga olmasdan.

cards.ex: He claimed the whole thing was a stitch-up by his rivals.
cards.exUz: Uning ta'kidlashicha, hammasi raqiblari tomonidan uyushtirilgan soxta ish edi.
cards.uzDef: Birovni ayblash uchun tuzilgan reja, fitna.

cards.ex: The police were finally able to close the case after finding new evidence.
cards.exUz: Politsiya yangi dalillarni topgandan so'ng nihoyat ishni yopishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Tekshiruvni yakunlash va ishni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: After prison, he promised to stay on the straight and narrow.
cards.exUz: Qamoqdan so'ng u to'g'ri yo'lda qolishga va'da berdi.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy va halol hayot kechirish.

cards.ex: The judge appointed a public defender to represent him.
cards.exUz: Sudya unga vakillik qilish uchun davlat himoyachisini tayinladi.
cards.uzDef: Pul to'lashga qurbi yetmaydiganlarga bepul yordam beradigan advokat.

cards.ex: As a repeat offender, he faced a much harsher sentence.
cards.exUz: Takroriy jinoyatchi sifatida u ancha qattiq jazoga duch keldi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat sodir etishni takrorlaydigan shaxs.

cards.ex: Despite the evidence, he managed to walk free.
cards.exUz: Dalillarga qaramay, u ozod bo'lishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda aybsiz deb topilib, ozodlikka chiqarish.

cards.ex: It's outrageous that he got off scot-free after all the damage he caused.
cards.exUz: U keltirgan barcha zararlardan keyin jazosiz qolgani g'azablanarli.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat uchun hech qanday jazo olmaslik.

cards.ex: Everyone is entitled to due process under the law.
cards.exUz: Har kim qonun bo'yicha tegishli tartibga haqli.
cards.uzDef: Qonun bilan belgilangan adolatli jarayon.

cards.ex: The witness's testimony was dismissed as hearsay evidence.
cards.exUz: Guvohning ko'rsatmalari g'iybat dalil sifatida rad etildi.
cards.uzDef: Ikkinchi qo'l ma'lumotlarga asoslangan dalil, sudga taqdim etilmaydi.

cards.ex: The lawyer objected to the leading question.
cards.exUz: Advokat yo'naltiruvchi savolga e'tiroz bildirdi.
cards.uzDef: Javobni taxmin qiladigan yoki istalgan javobga undaydigan savol.

cards.ex: If there's a reasonable doubt, the jury must acquit.
cards.exUz: Agar asosli shubha bo'lsa, hakamlar hay'ati oqlashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Agar aybdorlikka shubha bo'lsa, aybsizlik prezumpsiyasi qo'llaniladi.

cards.ex: It was proved beyond all doubt that he was guilty.
cards.exUz: Uning aybdorligi shubhasiz isbotlangan.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shubha bo'lishi mumkin emas, aniq isbotlangan.
